correctness.rationale: On L=m P_m tensor I_n+n I_m tensor P_n, the three nonconstant eigenspaces yield its exact pseudoinverse. Incident-edge transfer-current matrix has zero-sum eigenvalues (m+1)/(m(m+n)) and (n+1)/(n(m+n)), and the constant two-sector eigenvalues 1 and 2/(m+n). The determinantal tree-degree PGF therefore factors exactly. The second derivative of f_s =((4s-5)t-2)/[t^2((s-1)t-1)^2] is positive on [2,s-2], so the symmetric leaf factor minimizes at a balanced pair and maximizes at the endpoints. Le Cam plus elementary upper bounds gives TV <=17/(4s). Independently computed exact weighted-Laplacian cofactors for (2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(3,4), agreeing as complete polynomials, and symbolically differentiated f_s.
